fields.Name: Active Association Members with Geographic Coordinates and Organization
fields.Description: One row per currently active member, for maps and member directories: name, email, member number, segment, organization, full address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country), latitude/longitude, and membership expiry date. Active means a Confirmed annual membership purchase in the last 12 months that wasn't refunded, the same definition as the Membership Status query (its "Current" members); expiry is one year after the latest purchase. Address and coordinates come from the member profile. Every member has coordinates; some have no street address, and individual members have no organization.
fields.TechnicalDescription:
## Overview

This query returns all currently active members of the International Cheese Federation (ICF) association, including each member's organization/company name, contact details, address, and geographic coordinates. Active status is defined as having a confirmed, non‑refunded annual membership purchase within the trailing 12‑month window.

## Query Logic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[OrderHeaders + OrderLines + Products] -->|filter| B[Qualified Membership Orders]
    B -->|group by latest per Person| C[ActiveMembership CTE]
    C -->|join| D[MemberProfiles]
    C -->|join| E[People]
    D -->|add Organization column| F[Result Set]
```

## Data Sources

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderHeaders`)
- ID, BillToPersonID, Status, OrderDate, ReversesOrderHeaderID

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Lines (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderLines`)
- OrderHeaderID, ProductID

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Products (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwProducts`)
- ID, Name (ends with " Membership (annual)")

### MoreCheese: Member Profiles (`[morecheese_members].vwMemberProfiles`)
- PersonID, MemberNumber, Segment, Address fields, Latitude, Longitude, **Organization** (last‑known employer)

### MJ_BizApps_Common: People (`[__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwPeople`)
- ID, DisplayName, Email

## Relationships

- OrderHeaders → OrderLines → Products (via IDs)
- OrderHeaders.BillToPersonID = People.ID
- MemberProfiles.PersonID = People.ID

## Filters & Conditions

- Order status = 'Confirmed' and no reversal orders
- Product name LIKE '% Membership (annual)'
- Latest qualifying order date >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) (active window)
- Output sorted alphabetically by member name
```
